## Evidence

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (or the Chromium self-test, if Firefox does not start locally)
- [ ] Changelog entry as `changelog.d/<number or topic>.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` untouched
- [ ] `README.md` untouched; preset documentation in `docs/presets/<preset>.md`
- [ ] New tests form one section in `test/selftest.html`
